The marks, as a briefing prints them (a PROVEN lesson carries none):
- [fixture_creds] Test fixtures use low-entropy fake credentials *(UNCHECKED)*
- **FIX: Order lookups are scoped to the signed-in customer** [order_scope] *(UNVERIFIED — governs app/orders.py but no check has passed; prove it: okl verify order_scope --run …)*
- **FIX: Order lookups are scoped to the signed-in customer** [order_scope] *(STALE — app/orders.py changed 2026-11-02, after its last check on 2026-11-01; a lead, not a settled rule: …)*
- [token_in_storage] AVOID (retracted): Keep the session token in localStorage
